announcements.name: Links for ONLINE students
announcements.message:
Dear BUS225 Students,

Welcome to SERVICE MARKETING! A course that promises to be as intellectually engaging as it is demanding. 

Please make every effort to attend the first class (26th / 27th August). Beyond covering our first chapter, this session will lay out the assignment requirements and expectations that are essential to your success in the course. Missing it will put you at a real disadvantage from day one.

Online students, please note the following:

  • Wednesday class, please join the first link on LMS (Class 1)
  • Thursday class, please join the second link on LMS (Class 2).

I look forward to meeting you all and to the term ahead.

Regards,

Dana Khoury Eid
